title: QIMC TIES NEW SALEM-APPLE RIVER HELIUM ZONES TO A BURIED BASEMENT STRUCTURE: GRAVITY, MAGNETICS AND GEOCHEMISTRY CONVERGE ON A SINGLE FAULT-BOUNDED RAMP
text: HELIUM ANOMALIES CONCENTRATE WITHIN 1.5 KM OF FAULTS F-I, F-II AND F-III • A 10 KM × 2 KM MAGNETIC INTRUSIVE BODY IMAGED BENEATH ZONES B AND C ALONG F-III • SEISMIC PROGRAM EXPANDED TO APPROXIMATELY 50 KM • C1-C4 HYDROCARBON RESULTS BEING INTERPRETED MONTRÉAL, QUÉBEC--(NEWSFILE CORP. - SEPTEMBER 28, 2026) - QUÉBEC INNOVATIVE MATERIALS CORP. WORKING WITH PROFESSOR MARC RICHER-LAFLÈCHE, PH.D.

title: COTCHETT, PITRE & MCCARTHY ANNOUNCES OPENING OF $250 MILLION APPLE AI FALSE ADVERTISING SETTLEMENT CLAIMS PERIOD
